bitcoin_doesnt_have_bank_runs: Bitcoin Ilibe Kuthawa kwa Anthu Kumabanki
bank_runs_page_description: Mabanki amakongoza zomwe mwayika pansi pa dongosolo la nkhokwe yopanda yathunthu. Ngati anthu ambiri achotsa ndalama nthawi imodzi, mabanki akhoza kulephera. Bitcoin ndi dongosolo lokhala ndi nkhokwe yathunthu — kuthawira ku banki sikungachitike.
bank_runs_header: Bitcoin ilibe kuthawira ku banki, koma banki yanu ikhoza kukhala nako.
bank_runs_what: KUTHAWA KWA ANTHU KUMABANKI NDI CHIYANI?
bank_runs_what_p1: Mabanki samasunga zomwe mwayika m'chipinda chosungira. Amakongoza ndalama zanu ndi kuziyika — izi zimatchedwa fractional reserve banking.
bank_runs_what_p2: Ngati anthu ambiri ayesa kuchotsa ndalama nthawi imodzi, banki ilibe ndalama zokwanira kulipira aliyense. Imeneyo ndi bank run — ndipo ikhoza kupangitsa banki kugwa kwathunthu.
bank_runs_card_bank_reserve_detail: Kuyambira pa 26 March 2020, mabanki a U.S. amayenera kusunga 0% ngati nkhokwe.
bank_runs_card_btc_reserve_detail: Bitcoin iliyonse imakhalapo pa blockchain — palibe yomwe ikukongoletsedwa.
bank_runs_svb_p1_a: Mu March 2023, Silicon Valley Bank inalephera atatha kuyika zomwe makasitomala ayika m'mabondi a nthawi yayitali
bank_runs_svb_p1_b: Mabondiwo ataya mtengo wawo, SVB sinathe kupereka zochotsedwa. Banki idalephera.
bank_runs_svb_p2: Mabizinesi zikwizikwi sanathe kulipira antchito awo. FDIC inalowerera — koma izi zinapangitsa funso lalikulu: kodi ndalama zanu zili zotetezeka?
bank_runs_card_svb_title: Phunzirani momwe kuthawira ku Silicon Valley Bank kunachitikira
bank_runs_card_svb_source: Gwero: University of Washington School of Law →
bank_runs_fdic_heading: Inshuwalansi ya FDIC ikhulupilira pafupifupi 1% ya zomwe zayikidwa
bank_runs_fdic_p1: Inshuwalansi ya FDIC imateteza zomwe zayikidwa mpaka $250,000 pa wopereka aliyense. Koma ndalama za inshuwalansiyo ndi zochepa kwambiri poyerekeza ndi zomwe zayikidwa zonse zomwe ziyenera kutetezedwa.
bank_runs_fdic_p2_a: Mu kulephera kwakukulu kwa banki, boma likhoza kusindikiza ndalama kuti likwaniritse mpata — zomwe zikupangitsa kuwonjezeka kwa
bank_runs_card_fdic_detail: Ndalama za inshuwalansi za $153.9B vs $10.82T m'zomwe zayikidwa zoyikidwa inshuwalansi (Disembala 2025).
bank_runs_card_fdic_source: Gwero: FDIC Statistics at a Glance →
bank_runs_card_btc_fdic_detail: Dongosolo la nkhokwe yathunthu — palibe inshuwalansi yofunika ya zomwe zayikidwa.
bank_runs_bitcoin_p1: Bitcoin ndi dongosolo lokhala ndi nkhokwe yathunthu. Simukuyika ndalama zanu m'banki. Inu ndinu banki yanu yokha. Palibe wina amene amakongoletsa ndalama zanu popanda kuti mudziwe chifukwa inu nokha ndinu munthu okha amene angapeze ndalama zanu.
bank_runs_bitcoin_p2: Mukasunga Bitcoin mu chikwama chanu — osati pa exchange kapena moyikidwa mu ETF — kuthawira ku banki sikungachitike.
bank_runs_bitcoin_p3: Ndi Bitcoin, mukukhala ndi mphamvu zonse pa ndalama zanu.
bank_runs_card_wallet_title: Phunzirani momwe mungapezere chikwama chanu cha Bitcoin
